newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Egana to issue US$15.5 mln convertibles.
newsitem.headline: Egana to issue US$15.5 mln convertibles.

text.p: Egana International (Holdings) Ltd will issue US$15.5 million in convertible notes, the company said in an announcement published on Tuesday.
The notes will bear interest of 5.0 percent and will be repaid or converted into new shares, the notice said.
Subscription is expected to take place on or before May 1, it said.
The maximum number of shares to be issued on conversion of the notes will be limited to 80.60 million shares, representing about 5.82 percent of the issued share capital of the company, it said.
The gross proceeds from the issue will amount to about US$15.5 million, equivalent to HK$119.97 million.
The proceeds will be used primarily to further expand the business of the company by extending the distribution network of its core business, with the balance used for general working capital.

Cortez Capital Ltd, financial adviser to the company on the notes issue, will on completion be given an option to subscribe to 1,636,948 shares at HK$2.20 per share at any time within two years from the date of the issue of the notes.
